cheap.notes: Keep simple repetitive work local and escalate only when quality or write access demands it.

balanced.notes: Use the best planner, keep the builder specialized, and preserve a strong reviewer.

premium.notes: Favor higher-quality planners and reviewers when the task is risky or strategic.

quick_ping_strategy: Prefer local config, auth, or cache probes before heavy CLI status calls.
Hide console windows and keep the probe payload minimal.
Cache quick ping results for short repeat intervals.
deep_ping_strategy: Send a compact deterministic prompt that proves a real assistant roundtrip.
Capture framework label, target model or agent, and visible assistant text.
Return the permission posture used for the probe.
